title: Caitlin Clark Delivers on Courtside Photography Promise With Shot of Tyrese Haliburton and Fiancée Jade Jones - NewsBreak
text:
By Miguel de Guzman ,
1 hours ago
Mar 25, 2026; Indianapolis, Indiana, USA; Indiana Fever guard Caitlin Clark reacts to her logo being on the back of her court chair before the game between the Indiana Pacers and the Los Angeles Lakers at Gainbridge Fieldhouse. Mandatory Credit: Marc Lebryk-Imagn Images
Caitlin Clark attended the Indiana Pacers vs. Los Angeles Lakers game on Wednesday not only as a fan but also as a photographer. Later on, she posted one of the images she took, which she says turned out great despite the challenges.
Caitlin Clark Posts Photos of Tyrese Haliburton and Jade Jones at Pacers Game “Photographer” isn’t the first thing that comes to mind when people think of Clark. On Wednesday, though, she was out to prove that she was also a talented shutterbug.
During Wednesday’s matchup between the Lakers and Pacers, the Indiana Fever star was seen holding a camera. Her subject? Tyrese Haliburton and his fiancée, Jade Jones. She was filmed while she took a photo of them, and the clip was later posted to X (formerly Twitter) by sports photographer Bri Lewerke.
In Lewerke’s post, she playfully said that Clark was learning the challenges of being a photographer.
“Cailtin learning in real time the struggle of taking a close-up photo when you’re using a 70-200 lens,” she said .
Clark replied , saying, “Don’t doubt me. Wait till u see the product.”
Lewerke decided to poke fun at Clark by saying, “Let’s see if you can figure out how to get the photos off the SD card first.”
Later on, Clark posted the photo she took of Haliburton and Jones. “See turned out good for having no flash and zoomed in.”
Clark’s posting of the photos prompted another reply from Lewerke, praising the Fever star for her versatility. “Can you just be bad at something for once you’re so annoying,” she said .
Clark’s snapping a photo of Haliburton and Jones seemed like it was something she did for fun, but she was actually there in an official capacity . After the game, the Pacers even posted the photos she took while praising her for her skills.
This isn’t the first time she’s been documented with a camera in her hands, or the first time the photos she took were posted on social media. Lewerke, who serves as the Fever’s photographer, once shared an Instagram reel featuring images that Clark took with her camera.
This also isn’t the first time Clark has displayed the talents she has beyond the basketball court. Aside from photography, she also seemed to be a talented golfer, having participated in the LPGA’s Annika Pro-Am tourney.
